notes.title: Rules of the Tournament
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/e4a325d3fdf9139e1c54a9afbe0938d24ac931b3.jpg
Only several hours left before the start of the first Blazing Core Tournament! 
Gather a team, sign up at  google form  and join the battle for victory.

Our veteran players have already noticed a new game mode in the “Battle” tab — “Tournament”. To access it your team needs to register for the tournament. This is also where you’ll be able to find your opponents. 

What to do:
1. Launch the game at least once before the tournament. You will only need to enter the Hangar, nothing more. That is to let us find you and add you to your team.
2. You and two of your allies need to add each other to the friends list in Steam. Otherwise, you won’t be able to form a party inside the game. Important: you can’t add friends in Steam if your account has no games.
3. Launch the game and form a party.
4. Wait for the tournament to start and choose the “Tournament” game mode.
5. Battle!

The matches will last from 17:00 to 19:00 (UTC). The teams will fight each other for two hours. We have chosen a simple scoring system for the first tournament. Each win will net you 3 points, each loss — 1 point.
The points earnt by your team are added up at the end of the matches. The team that gained the most points wins the tournament.


In case there is a tie, we will use additional stats: personal encounters, the number of rounds won, etc. We will do it ourselves, all you need to do is play and have fun. 

See you at the tournament today!

notes.title: Alpha Test 16 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/31b954f53727b8953f77a3e96a6aa8844dc78768.png

Features

● Party system. Teamwork is very important for our tactical shooter. And now you can join forces with your friends from Steam and form parties. Create a dream team and together lead your mechs onto battlefield! 
More info here.

● Leaving battles prematurely. In Blazing Core every player is valuable to the team. But during battles emotions run high and some mech pilots might quit the match prematurely. So, we’re adding a penalty system for such players. You can quit the match before it ends but if you do you will lose all of your hard-earned rewards and will not receive any experience points or crowns. Don’t give up, fight till the very end, and don’t let your team down!

● Achievements. You can find the achievements’ list in the hangar. Check out which of them you’ve already earned and learn what you need to do to get the rest.

Fixed bugs

You can quit game mode menu and go to the hangar by pressing ESC
You can close post battle statistics by pressing ESC
Kara’s Shock Grenades now fall to the ground after hitting Gregor’s shield



Balance

General 
• Visualized mines’ timers for activation and explosions
• Reworked damage system 
• Fixed the delay between the shots (for mines, grenades, mortar)

Martinus 
• Napalm is back! But new and better. Time to burn and set things on fire again!

Kara 
• Electric Rifle - decreased damage

Gregor 
• Plasma Launcher - increased dam

notes.title: Alpha Test 15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/a7d7f90c2529f151ba5b18ea12bd82eb5683948d.jpg

Features

●  Battle rewards. A knight deserves a worthy reward for feats of bravery on the battlefield. We are adding a system of battle achievements to commend your actions during combat. Fight, combine mechs’ abilities, play alongside your team, and earn medals.

● Post battle statistics. There’s nothing wrong with wanting to know how well you fought after a hard battle. Or check out the stats of a leader you look up to. Our new statistics screen will show you all the medals you earned during the battle and you will be able to see how much each player contributed to the victory.

● New mech’s name. Our jumping mech finally got a name - Ventum - which is Latin for “wind”. Our thanks go to Blazing Core community for helping us pick the name. From their many and varied suggestions we’ve chosen three names which eventually were put to a vote. And the winner - Ventum - is perfect for the fastest mech in the game.

● Martinus ultimate ability. Martinus’ formidable ultimate ability got a new targeting interface. Also, our artists have come up with a way to warn the player when he is about to be bombarded with a rain of fire. Take part in the test and test your reaction time!

● New matchmaking. We are still working on bypassing Roskomnadzor blocks. One answer to this problem is our new, completely reworked, matchmaking system. Though we can’t promise it’ll work perfectly yet. If you run into any issues while matchmaking - shoot us a message in our Discord channel: discord.gg/QrWknhU



Fixed bugs

You can no longer go out of map’s bounds on the training area and 3x3 map
You can now aim with Gregor’s Shield Cannon
Added detailed perks’ descriptions. Now it should be clear what they affect!
The bullets no longer “sway” together with the mech when it moves sideways - now they fly exactly where you send them.


Balance

General 
• It now takes longer to plant the mines, so there’s no longer any point in using them as grenades
• Mine damage is depends on distance - the farther the mech the lower the damage
• Fixed some perk values
• Balanced perks that give an additional bullet (for example, they may lower the damage a bit)


Warmaster 
• Can now walk faster when all of his additional weapons are offline
• But when his additional weapons are online, he is now even slower

Ventum
• Lowered scanner debuff’s power

Cordelia
• Enforced drone’s armor

notes.title: Alpha Test 14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/9d1bda2e92cb34490763a248cd055b3e51c6aba2.png

Features

● New Martinus. Our old mech got himself new looks as wells as new and upgraded weapons. Just try evading his ultimate ability now!

● New menu. We’ve changed the game mode menu. Now the “Battle” button will open a big window with all the usual suspects: Versus AI, Training, Quick Play.

● Four modules for all mechs. Kara, Martinus, and Gregor now have the same number of abilities as the rest of the mechs.


Fixed Bugs


No more slippery disappearing mines! We think. If you do notice one of these devils, please, tell us!
Got rid of autologin during the very first launch of the game. Now life should be easier for new players!
Sounds in the training room no longer disappear.
Fixed shop issues that appeared due to VPN use.
Bug Report button in windowed mode now should work correctly.
We took away Scout’s semitransparent ghost modules and gave him normal ones.



Balance

Gregor 
• His ultimate ability is back! The impulse generator now deals damage and slows down the enemy at the same time. Armor damage is lowered by 50%, speed drop is down by 30%.

Kara
• Storm Generator AJE123-AS - Hvergelmir (F) — a storm will erupt across the battlefield once more.
• Supercharger DU122-PS - Gjoll (E) – additional damage is lowered by 10%.

notes.title: Alpha Test 13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/75ff9c8c8475aaaa754edacef5771e4a14fe20e5.png

Features

● Shooting refactoring. We are steadily improving every aspect of the game and it’s all thanks to your feedback. Shooting is one of Blazing Core’s most important elements so we do our best to make it feel as good as we can. 

● Voice chat. Now you will be able to talk with your teammates as long as you have a mic. And, as you know, teamwork is half the battle in Blazing Core. 

● In-game notifications. You will receive the notifications about the latest news right inside the game. If you think email is for fossils, this new feature should be right up your alley. 

● Warmaster got a new weapon. Jab, twin shotguns for the main weapon slot, deal a lot of damage at close distance. Usahi, a pair of precise thermite rifles for the second weapon slot, fire in short bursts and deal additional damage over time.

● Scout got new effects. Some devs take that as more evidence that we all live in the Matrix! Just press Q while playing as Scout and you will see.


Bugs fixed

Fixed poor bot shooting. Some day our bots will become smart enough to take over the world. We try to stall their progress, but for the time being we got them to aim better.
Kara: when using Lighting Gun the sound no longer disappears. Pew-pew!
Fixed shooting visual effects of all mechs.
Scout: one press of a button no longer causes several mines to appear. Also, Scout’s mines now bounce off surfaces properly and don’t stick to walls and ceilings. If you quickly throw two mines in a row, the second one won’t disappear.
Scout: main weapon no longer reloads after every shot.
Scout no longer gets stuck in the training room. 



Balance

Warmaster
•Missile Launcher ML538 Makombora (E) – damage reduced by 15%
•Dual Guncannon CN582 Haiwezekan (Q) – damage reduced by 17%
•Projector AC559 Jicho (F) – damage increased by 15%


Game Mode Changes

You score victory points for capturing and controlling map points
Killing the whole enemy team will win you the round
Point capture timer has been decreased
Score victory timer has been decreased

notes.title: Cписок изменений одиннадцатой альфы
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/4fb64d4734568a6265395ebeef30d0dad9155ac7.png

Фичи

• Новый мех, Корделия, который приносит с собой новую игровую механику! Отличительная особенность Корделии – наличие дрона-помощника. Подробно об этом читайте тут. 

• Кастомизация. Мы добавили в игру красивые скины, чтобы вы могли выделиться на поле боя и придать индивидуальности своим любимым мехах. Скины выпадают из лутбоксов.

• Интеграция с Discord. Теперь в Дискорде будет отображаться сообщение, что вы играете в Blazing Core. Это только начало, у нас запланирована куча крутых фичей.

• Улучшен интерфейс захвата точек и генерации очков. Теперь всё стало более наглядно, красиво и понятно.

• Улучшена система перков. Теперь они оказывают более существенное влияние на баланс, а у вас есть возможность тонко настроить оружие под свой стиль игры.


Исправлены баги:


FPS не падает во время регенерации брони
Игра больше не вылетает во время матча с ИИ
Kara – Electric Rifle – beam-эффект при выстреле на дальние расстояния теперь выглядит правильно
Исправлено отображение полоски брони в сетевом режиме
Звук поиска игры больше не зацикливается
Temple Conquest: игроки больше не появляются в начале раунда друг на друге
Temple Conquest: починили индикацию захвата точек
Temple Conquest: точки на миникарте теперь отображаются корректно
Gregor – Plasmagun: поправили анимацию пушки после выстрела
Интерфейс в первом раунде теперь не пропадает
Индикатор здоровья в начале раунда теперь тоже ведёт себя как положено
Исправлено отображение отрицательного значения урона
За убийство союзника или себя победные очки больше не отнимаются
Количество зарядов у способностей во время матча с ИИ теперь отображается верно
Исправлено сообщение, появляющееся во время действия стана
Warmaster – Jicho: ульта (F) теперь правильно работает в сетевом режиме
После смерти меха в топ баре отображается правильная иконка
Обновлены экраны загрузки


Баланс

Корделия:
• Дрон регенерирует свою энергию в два раза быстрее (за 4 секунды)
• Изменена кривая урона. Перепады урона от дистанции стали ещё заметней (кемперить теперь будет сложно)

Грегор:
• Броня и ХП увеличены на 15%

Мартинус:
• Союзники больше не могут уничтожить ваши мины. Радиус действия вражеских мин теперь не виден.

notes.title: Alpha Test 11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32271965/4fb64d4734568a6265395ebeef30d0dad9155ac7.png

Features

• A new mech, Cordelia, that brings with her a new game mechanic! Cordelia’s special feature is a helper-drone. Details here. 

• Customization. We’ve added beautiful skins to the game so that you can show off your mech on the battlefield and add a bit of a personal touch to your favorites. You can get skins from lootboxes.

• Discord integration. Now, if you’re playing Blazing Core, Discord will show an appropriate status. But that’s just the beginning, we have a lot more features planned.

• Improved interface for map points capture and score generation. It’s much clearer, prettier, and more informative now.

• Improved perk system. Perks’ influence on the balance is now much greater and you can adjust and tinker with your weapons until they fully suit your playstyle.


Bugs fixed:


Fixed FPS drops during armor regeneration
The game no longer crashes during AI matches
Kara – Electric Rifle – beam effect when shooting at long range is now displayed correctly
Fixed the way armor bars are displayed in online mode
The match search sounds no longer loop forever
Temple Conquest: players no longer spawn right on top of each other at the start of the round
Temple Conquest: fixed point capture indication
Temple Conquest: points on the minimap are now displayed correctly
Gregor – Plasmagun: fixed gun animation after a shot 
The interface no longer disappears in the first round 
Health indicator now works correctly as well at the start of the round
Fixed the way negative damage is displayed 
You no longer lose victory points for killing yourself or your allies
The amount of charges for your abilities is now displayed correctly during AI matches 
Fixed the message that appears while stun is in effect
Warmaster – Jicho: Ultimate ability (F) now works correctly in online mode
After the death of the mech the top bar displays the correct icon
Updated loading screens


Balance

Cordelia:
• The drone regenerates energy twice as fast (in 4 seconds)
• Changed damage curve. Changes in damage that depend on distance are now even more noticeable (camping is going to be hard now)

Gregor:
• Armor and HP are increased by 15%.

Martinus:
• Allies can no longer destroy your mines. You can no longer see the blast radius of enemy mines.
